## Resume bullets (numbers filled in from this run)
- Developed 4 SQL-based fraud detection rules on 4.2M+ transactions, raising fraud recall from 0.19% (existing threshold control) to 61.87% with a combined rule set.
- Built an XGBoost fraud classifier trained on 20 days and validated on 10 held-out days, reaching 99.48% recall at 98.14% precision (PR-AUC 1.00).
- Produced an Excel analyst alert queue and monitoring report tracking alert volume, precision, and recall by rule.
